full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that the present petitioner being complainant filed CR Case No. 19 of 2019 before the Court of learned Senior Special Judge, Cox's Bazar under sections 419/465/409/467/468/471/34 of the Penal Code, 1860 with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 against the accused-opposite parties stating, inter-alia that the government acquired 73 acre of land of BS dag Nos. 293 and 295 corresponding to BS Khatian No. 128 under Mouza Chiringa, Cox's Bazar. On Golam Kader, Ahmed Hossain, Gul Cheher, Gul Nahar and Mazeda Khatun were the owner of the said land and their names were recorded and published in BS Khatian No. 128 of Mouza Chiringa, Cox's Bazar. The BS tenant Gul Cheher sold out her share of land to Golam Kader and Ahmed Hossain, the father of complainant by way of registered deed No.2000 dated 2-5-1987. After the death of the father of the complainant, the complainant and witnesses inherited the property and got possession of the scheduled land. The aforesaid land was acquired by the government and LA section of the office of the deputy commissioner issued notice upon the complainant and witnesses of the instant case for taking compensation. But the accused-opposite parties took away the award money of the complainant and witnesses of the instant case by practicing fraud and corruption upon the office of the Deputy Commissioner and the complainant-petitioner and the witnesses of the case. Hence, the petition of complaint.
